rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for casually greeting or addressing someone.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 daa2 ziu1 fu1

rows.note: Use this when you mean warmly welcoming someone rather than simply saying hello.

example.english: We greet the new colleague warmly at the door.
example.traditional: 我哋喺門口歡迎新同事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 mun4 hau2 fun1 jing4 san1 tung4 si6

rows.note: Use this passive construction when something is seen or perceived by someone.

example.english: I wave from afar so Ming can see me and come over to greet me.
example.traditional: 我喺遠處揮手，畀阿明見到我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 jyun5 cyu3 fai1 sau2 bei2 aa3 ming4 gin3 dou2 ngo5
